name: diorama_ingame
description: The Diorama as it runs during a match: the playable map covers the arena, so every in-game actor on the grid owns a small mannequin on the model that production updates every tick (position, pose, held items every 4 ticks), `lobby` actors stand around the model looking at its spawn buttons (giant mannequins plus the hover raycasts), 16 buttons exist, and the piercing-weapon add/remove pass runs for everyone with a sword in hand.
